titulo: Apple’s foldable ‘iPhone Duo’ will reportedly start at $2,000
cuerpo: With only a few hours left until the first iPhone launch event since John Ternus took over as the CEO of Apple, Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman says the name of the company's long-rumored folding phone is the iPhone Duo.
